lead: Getting to know a church is a real challenge in these times. We hope the information here gives you a clearer picture of who we are and what we believe. You are welcome to visit whenever you like.

pillars.title: Centered on Christ
pillars.desc: The cross is at the center of everything we do.

pillars.title: Faithful to the Word
pillars.desc: Scripture is our authority and guide.

pillars.title: Family of faith
pillars.desc: Growing together in love and service.
